_comment: S188 APEX PREDATOR — the elite piranha. Built by scripts/build-scattered-sheet-atlas.mjs.
Three already-matted 8x3 sheets from the owner; frames overlap (no gutters) and the pitch is irregular,
so components are assigned to the nearest fitted body and each frame is aligned on its centroid.
SIZE: the swim frames' median body height is fitted to 128 px in a 200 px cell — the SHIPPED piranha's
measured body height (check-atlas-scenery's own measure) — so PIRANHA_ELITE_SPRITE_SCALE_MUL = 2 is
exactly his 'two times bigger than the current piranha'.
idle and walk share the swim loop (every other frame = one full cycle in 12); die stops at frame 21:
frames 22-24 are flat saturated-blue blots, not art (inspected S188).
name: t3-nagas-piranha-elite
